title: [T1-a policy vocabulary] Policy-declared risk classification: a slice-level fact-tier table plus a closed node-property fact-id vocabulary the daemon derives, never a planner tier
description:
FILED per the HUMAN-RATIFIED riskTier ruling T1 POLICY-DECLARED (comment-c86c35cb on task-ba102165, governor 17:47Z): "policy rules assign risk from inspectable node properties; the PLANNER DECLARES ONLY PROPERTIES, NEVER A TIER; unclassifiable node shapes REFUSE rather than defaulting". Leaf of three (this → [T1-b producer] → [T1-c reader]); PLAN IN BUILD ORDER.

THE GAP, MEASURED AT HEAD 5b3d7313: the core evaluator derives the tier ONLY from tier-bearing FACTS with strong truth — packages/core/src/policy/policy-evaluation.ts:56-63 `assessRisk` folds `fact.tier` via maxTier; no tier-bearing fact leaves computedTier null (:51 "never a silent R0"). Rules cannot express properties: `PolicyRule` (policy-contract.ts:79-84) = {effect, obligations, requiredFactIds, ruleId} and `assessRules` matches on requiredFactIds only (:119); `PolicySlice` (:95-99) = {autoApprovalOptIns, rules, sliceRef}. The only production fact source is `resolvePolicyFact` (apps/daemon/src/bootstrap/policy-fact-resolver.ts:44) → readPolicyRisk → the ACTIVATION-written policy-risk record (circular for a fresh run). So "policy-declared risk from node properties" needs TWO vocabulary pieces that do not exist: (1) a POLICY-side table mapping fact ids to tiers (declared in the slice, so a policy revision — not daemon code, not an agent — decides risk); (2) a DAEMON-side closed vocabulary of node-property fact ids (e.g. `node.command_kind:<kind>`, `node.scope:<scope>`, `node.target:<target>`) derived deterministically from inspectable node content the graph revision already carries (measure the node content contract: graph-supersede-approval-binding.ts:66-67 reads `successorContent.nodeAuthority.authorities[].nodeKey`; approval-intent-sources.ts:35 `approvedNodeScope`).

DELIVER: core policy contract gains `riskClassifications: readonly { factId: string; tier: PolicyRiskTier }[]` on PolicySlice (exact-key rosters updated: the authority reader's `exactObject(slices[0], ["autoApprovalOptIns","rules","sliceRef"])` bootstrap-policy-authority-reader.ts:189, slice codec/digest `derivePolicySliceDigest`, install validation) and a pure `deriveNodePropertyFacts(nodeContent, classifications)` in @moe/core that yields PolicyFactInput[] with truthClass DAEMON_VERIFIED for each property the slice classifies and NONE for unclassified properties — so the evaluator's existing null-tier path REFUSES (unclassifiable ≠ lowest tier). No daemon wiring here (T1-b). Consumer: [T1-b producer].
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK first, in a row comment with `git rev-parse HEAD` quoted, greps unpiped with exit codes plus a positive control: `git grep -n 'riskClassifications\|deriveNodePropertyFacts' HEAD -- packages/core/src apps/daemon/src` EXIT 1 (gap open; EXIT 0 = adopt/verify/report duplicate); `PolicySlice` still = {autoApprovalOptIns, rules, sliceRef} (policy-contract.ts:95-99) and `assessRisk` still folds fact.tier only (policy-evaluation.ts:56-63); the NODE CONTENT CONTRACT the properties come from is measured and quoted (file:line of the node record type with its inspectable fields — nodeKey, command kind, scope/targets); every exact-key roster that pins the slice shape is enumerated (authority reader :189, slice codec/digest, install validation, index-surface/export tests) and owned. Ruling comment-c86c35cb quoted.

PolicySlice gains `riskClassifications` (fact id -> PolicyRiskTier), validated at policy install (bounded ids, valid tiers, no duplicate fact ids), folded across the chain with the same tighten-only rule as rules (a later slice may raise a fact's tier, never lower it — arm), and covered by the slice digest so a classification change changes policyRef; every roster pin updated in the same commit; existing slices without the field are REFUSED by the strict reader (no defaulting) — or admitted as empty only if the migration ruling on the row says so.

`deriveNodePropertyFacts(nodeContent, classifications)` (pure, @moe/core) emits, for each inspectable node property in the CLOSED vocabulary, a PolicyFactInput {factId: '<vocabulary>:<value>', tier: <classified tier or null>, truthClass: 'DAEMON_VERIFIED'} — and an UNCLASSIFIED property yields tier null so the evaluator's computedTier stays null and the evaluation is unclassifiable (fail-closed, its own arm per ruling condition 3); a property outside the vocabulary is REFUSED with an exact code (never silently skipped); the vocabulary is a frozen roster with a bidirectional pin test.

No planner/agent field can carry a tier: an arm proves that a node content record carrying any `tier`/`riskTier`/`risk` key is refused by the node content validator (exact code+layer) and that deriveNodePropertyFacts reads only the vocabulary's properties (mutation: add a `tier` property to a node -> the refusal arm reds).

Mutation drills with SHA256 restore proofs: lower a tier in a later slice -> the tighten-only arm reds; drop a classification -> the unclassifiable arm reds; drop the field from the slice digest material -> the policyRef-changes arm reds. Gates standalone/unpiped with counts: `pnpm test` (root lane covers packages/core; quote counts), `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` and the strict reader/install suites from apps/daemon; every production source <= 250 lines; explicit-pathspec commit; completion comment names [T1-b producer] as consumer and states: 'risk is now declarable in policy per fact id; the daemon can derive node-property facts; no tier can originate from a planner'.
taskRails: The planner declares properties only; no schema, payload, or fixture may carry a tier into the chain. Unclassifiable never defaults to a low tier — it refuses (ruling condition 3).
Compose the existing evaluator (assessRisk / maxTier / strongTruth); never add a second tier derivation; classifications are POLICY data covered by the slice digest, never daemon constants.
Exact-key rosters (slice shape, reader, codec, install) are enumerated at plan time and owned; the shape change fans out into generated/pinned surfaces per epic rail 7B.
Leaf of the T1 chain: land before [T1-b producer]; no daemon wiring here. Explicit-pathspec commits; foreign WIP preserved; <=250 lines per production source; TDD red-first.

(B) DIGEST COMPAT: the digest of a fixture slice WITHOUT the field equals the digest WITH `riskClassifications: []` and equals the pre-row literal pinned from policy-slice-digest.test.ts (quote it); a non-empty table changes the digest; two tables with the same entries in different order digest equal (canonical sort by factId). (C) TIGHTEN-ONLY FOLD: chain [root classifies X:R1] + [child classifies X:R2] folds to X:R2; [root X:R2] + [child X:R1] REFUSES with the composition module's own code (measured in step 1); child adding a new fact Y:R3 is admitted; child omitting X keeps root's X (never a removal). (D) DERIVATION: `deriveNodePropertyFacts({ nodeKey: "n1", commandKind: "shell", scope: ["repo"], targets: ["packages/core"] }, classifications)` yields PolicyFactInput[] with factIds exactly ["node.command_kind:shell","node.scope:repo","node.target:packages/core"] (sorted), each `truthClass: "DAEMON_VERIFIED"`, tier = the classified tier or null; run `evaluatePolicy` with those facts and a slice classifying only command_kind -> computedTier equals that tier; with NO classifications -> computedTier null and the evaluation is unclassifiable (assert the exact refusal outcome the evaluator already emits for null tier — the fail-closed arm, ruling condition 3). (E) CLOSED VOCABULARY: `NODE_PROPERTY_KINDS` is frozen and equals exactly ["command_kind","scope","target"] (bidirectional pin with the derivation's emitted prefixes); a NodeProperties record with an extra key (`tier`, `riskTier`, `risk`, or anything) is REFUSED with an exact code (never silently dropped) — the no-planner-tier arm; an empty scope/targets array is admitted (yields no facts of that kind). (F) NO SECOND DERIVATION: evaluatePolicy's assessRisk is unchanged — assert `computedTier` equals `maxTier` over the derived facts computed independently in the arm. Run `pnpm test` at the root (the root lane covers packages/core; quote counts) or `pnpm --filter @moe/core test` if it exists (confirm the count line prints); quote the reds.

(2) policy-validation.ts: the slice validator accepts EXACTLY the 3-key roster or EXACTLY the 4-key roster (`SLICE_KEYS` and `SLICE_KEYS_WITH_CLASSIFICATIONS`, both frozen); `riskClassifications`, when present, must be an exact array of exact records {factId bounded non-empty, tier in POLICY_RISK_TIERS}, factIds unique; export `classificationsOf(slice): readonly PolicyRiskClassification[]` returning [] for absent. GREEN — NEW packages/core/src/policy/policy-node-facts.ts (<= 250) + bridge policy-node-facts.js (`export * from "./policy-node-facts.ts";`, LF, matching the 8 sibling bridges in policy/). Exports: `NODE_PROPERTY_KINDS = Object.freeze(["command_kind","scope","target"] as const)`; `interface NodeProperties { readonly nodeKey: string; readonly commandKind: string; readonly scope: readonly string[]; readonly targets: readonly string[] }` validated as an EXACT record (extra key => refusal `NODE_PROPERTIES_KEY_UNKNOWN`; bounded strings; arrays of bounded strings) — the closed input the producer assembles; `deriveNodePropertyFacts(properties: unknown, classifications: readonly PolicyRiskClassification[]): { ok: true, facts: readonly PolicyFactInput[] } | { ok: false, code, layer: "POLICY_NODE_FACTS" }` emitting one fact per (kind,value) with factId `node.<kind>:<value>`, truthClass "DAEMON_VERIFIED", tier = classified tier or null, sorted by factId, deterministic; no clock, no randomness; the layer constant is module-private (no column-zero `*_LAYER` export — boundary-roster scanner).
